title: Sales and demand: hospital forecast vs consumption
description: How well hospital demand was forecast, and where it went unmet.

list.name: disease_category
list.label: Disease category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT disease_category FROM mart.dim_medicine WHERE is_current AND medicine_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT disease_category FROM mart.dim_medicine WHERE is_current AND medicine_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1

list.name: hospital
list.label: Hospital
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT hospital_name FROM mart.dim_hospital WHERE is_current AND hospital_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT hospital_name FROM mart.dim_hospital WHERE is_current AND hospital_key <> 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Over forecast
panels.description: Consumption vs forecast: (packs consumed - packs forecast) / packs forecast x 100, from summed packs. A plus sign means hospitals consumed more than forecast (under-forecast).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN v >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || round(v, 1)::text || '%' FROM (
                   SELECT 100.0 * (sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs))
                          / NULLIF(sum(f.forecast_demand_packs), 0) AS v FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)) t

panels.title: Forecast WAPE
panels.description: Weighted absolute percentage error: sum of |consumed - forecast| at hospital, medicine and month level / sum consumed x 100. Lower is better; over- and under-forecasts do not cancel. No sparkline: a ratio must come from summed numerator and denominator, not an average of months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(abs(f.consumed_quantity_packs - f.forecast_demand_packs))
                       / NULLIF(sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs), 0), 2) FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Fill rate
panels.description: Request fill rate: packs received / packs requested x 100 (ratio of sums). Green at 95% or more, amber from 90%, red below. The 95% target is our assumption: the source defines no service-level agreement.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(f.received_quantity_packs)
                       / NULLIF(sum(f.requested_quantity_packs), 0), 2) FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Service level
panels.description: Dispensing service level: share of demand that could be dispensed = 1 - unfulfilled / (dispensed + unfulfilled). This is what the source's ServiceLevelPct measures; it differs from the request fill rate beside it (decision 14). Green at 99% or more.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * (1 - sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs)::numeric
                       / NULLIF(sum(f.dispensed_quantity_packs) + sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs), 0)), 2)
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)

panels.title: Unfulfilled
panels.description: Packs of demand that could not be met (source value). Sparkline: packs per month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.full_date::timestamp AS time, sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) AS value FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY d.full_date ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stockout days
panels.description: Days with a stockout, summed over hospital, medicine and month records. Sparkline: per month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.full_date::timestamp AS time, sum(f.stockout_days) AS value FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY d.full_date ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Forecast vs consumption (packs per month)
panels.description: Packs consumed (filled cyan) against packs forecast (dashed slate), per month. Consumption runs about 1% above forecast, so the cyan area sits just over the dashed line. The axis ends at the last month with data and grows as refreshes land.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM d.full_date) * 1000 AS month, sum(f.forecast_demand_packs) AS "Forecast",
                         sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) AS "Consumed" FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital)
                  GROUP BY d.full_date ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Over/under forecast by disease category (%)
panels.description: Variance from summed packs per disease category; positive = consumed more than forecast. Teal under 1%, amber from 1%, coral from 1.3%: the top three categories are where the forecast under-calls most.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE m.disease_category WHEN 'Pain and Inflammatory Conditions' THEN 'Pain & Inflammation' WHEN 'Neurological and Mental Health Conditions' THEN 'Neuro & Mental Health' WHEN 'Gastrointestinal Disease' THEN 'Gastrointestinal' WHEN 'Cardiovascular Disease' THEN 'Cardiovascular' WHEN 'Respiratory Disease' THEN 'Respiratory' WHEN 'Infectious Disease' THEN 'Infectious' WHEN 'Diabetes Mellitus' THEN 'Diabetes' ELSE m.disease_category END AS "disease category",
                        round(100.0 * (sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs))
                              / NULLIF(sum(f.forecast_demand_packs), 0), 2) AS "Variance (%)"
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY m.disease_category ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Largest forecast gaps by medicine
panels.description: The ten medicines whose total consumption is furthest from forecast, in packs. The bar shows the gap in packs; variance (%) turns amber from 1.5% and coral from 2%. WAPE shows month-by-month error even where over- and under-forecasts cancel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.generic_name AS medicine,
                         sum(f.forecast_demand_packs) AS forecast, sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) AS consumed,
                         sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs) AS "variance (packs)",
                         round(100.0 * (sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs))
                               / NULLIF(sum(f.forecast_demand_packs), 0), 2) AS "variance (%)",
                         round(100.0 * sum(abs(f.consumed_quantity_packs - f.forecast_demand_packs))
                               / NULLIF(sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs), 0), 2) AS "WAPE (%)"
                  FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1
                  ORDER BY abs(sum(f.consumed_quantity_packs) - sum(f.forecast_demand_packs)) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Unfulfilled demand by month (packs)
panels.description: Demand that could not be met, per month. Slate under 50 packs, amber from 50, coral from 150; the dashed line marks 150 packs. The late-2024 and late-2025 spikes are the shortage peaks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(d.full_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) AS "Unfulfilled packs"
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Unfulfilled packs: hospital x disease category
panels.description: A heat map: each cell is the unfulfilled packs for one hospital and disease category in the selected period. Darker amber/coral = more unmet demand; neutral = none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replace(replace(h.hospital_name, 'Medical Center', 'Med Ctr'), 'Hospital', 'Hosp.') AS hospital, coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) FILTER (WHERE m.disease_category = 'Pain and Inflammatory Conditions'), 0) AS "Pain & Inflammation",
                         coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) FILTER (WHERE m.disease_category = 'Neurological and Mental Health Conditions'), 0) AS "Neuro & Mental Health",
                         coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) FILTER (WHERE m.disease_category = 'Gastrointestinal Disease'), 0) AS "Gastrointestinal",
                         coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) FILTER (WHERE m.disease_category = 'Cardiovascular Disease'), 0) AS "Cardiovascular",
                         coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) FILTER (WHERE m.disease_category = 'Respiratory Disease'), 0) AS "Respiratory",
                         coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) FILTER (WHERE m.disease_category = 'Infectious Disease'), 0) AS "Infectious",
                         coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) FILTER (WHERE m.disease_category = 'Diabetes Mellitus'), 0) AS "Diabetes",
                         coalesce(sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs), 0) AS "Total"
                  FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY h.hospital_name ORDER BY "Total" DESC

panels.title: Unfulfilled demand hotspots (top 15 hospital-medicine pairs)
panels.description: The fifteen hospital and medicine pairs with the most unmet demand. The bar shows unfulfilled packs; fill rate is amber below 95% and coral below 90%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.hospital_name AS hospital, m.generic_name AS medicine,
                         sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) AS "unfulfilled packs",
                         round(100.0 * sum(f.received_quantity_packs)
                               / NULLIF(sum(f.requested_quantity_packs), 0), 1) AS "fill rate (%)",
                         sum(f.stockout_days) AS "stockout days"
                  FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING sum(f.unfulfilled_demand_packs) > 0
                  ORDER BY 3 DESC, 5 DESC LIMIT 15

defaults.noValue: No unfulfilled demand in this selection

panels.title: Stockout days by hospital (hospitals with at least one)
panels.description: Days with a stockout, by hospital, summed over medicines and months. Slate 1-9 days, amber 10-29, coral 30 or more. Hospitals with no stockout days are not drawn (see the heat map).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.hospital_name AS hospital, sum(f.stockout_days) AS "Stockout days"
                 FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(f.stockout_days) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Request fill rate by month (%)
panels.description: Packs received / packs requested, by month, on a 88-96% axis so the movement is shown in honest proportion. The dashed green line is the assumed 95% target: the rate stays about 2 points below it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM d.full_date) * 1000 AS month, round(100.0 * sum(f.received_quantity_packs)
                                / NULLIF(sum(f.requested_quantity_packs), 0), 2) AS "Fill rate (%)"
                  FROM mart.fact_hospital_demand f
       JOIN mart.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.demand_month_key
       JOIN mart.dim_medicine m ON m.medicine_key = f.medicine_key
       JOIN mart.dim_hospital h ON h.hospital_key = f.hospital_key
       WHERE $__timeFilter(d.full_date) AND m.disease_category IN ($disease_category)
         AND h.hospital_name IN ($hospital) GROUP BY d.full_date ORDER BY 1
